import_intro: Upload a staging file made by the import script. You see a preview first and nothing is written until you confirm. Organizations already imported are skipped, so you can upload the same file again.
import_error_json: This file is not valid JSON.
import_error_file: The file does not match the staging format. Check these fields:
import_error_site: This file was made for another site.
import_failed: The import did not work. Try again.
import_plan_summary: {total} organizations in the file: {created} new, {existing} already imported.
import_duplicate_existing_name: has the same name as the existing listing {other}
import_duplicate_existing_website: has the same website as the existing listing {other}
import_duplicate_file_name: has the same name as an earlier row in this file
import_duplicate_file_website: has the same website as an earlier row in this file
import_warning_no_email: no contact email, so no claim email can be prepared
import_warning_town_pin: the pin is only accurate to the town
import_warning_unknown_tag: the topic tag {tag} does not exist, run the tag seed first
import_done: Imported {created} organizations, skipped {skipped} that were already there.
import_pins_intro: Imported listings without an exact pin. Open each one and set the address and pin by hand.
import_pins_none: Every imported listing has an exact pin.
import_blocked_tags: Some topic tags do not exist yet. Run the tag seed first, then preview again.
import_pins_error: The pin check could not be loaded.
